subject: general
question: volleyball is played by two teams of _______ players each.
solution:
The correct answer is__** six.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Volleyball **is played by **two teams **of **six players** each.
 
• Each team has **three front-row players** and **three back-row players.**
 
• The game is played with a** ball and a net **dividing the court into two sides.
 
• The objective of the game is to score points by** hitting the ball over the net** and into the opponent's court.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Eight players** are usually required for **co-ed volleyball,** where there must be **at least three female players** on the court at all times.
 
• **Five players** are typically used in **beach volleyball,** where there is** no front-row **or** back-row division.**
 
• **Seven players** are used in** indoor and outdoor variants** of water volleyball.
